primary_blockers: No point-in-time ordinary-common-stock taxonomy; broad US_EQUITY can turn LOW-MAX into a product-type classifier.
No exact final-month-close to first-next-month-open policy; the generic monthly scheduler is one daily bar late.
secondary_rejection_evidence: Published economics are driven substantially by high-MAX underperformance, not proven standalone low-MAX alpha.
The proposed six-name long-only translation is unsupported by the diversified long-short literature.
MAX overlaps strongly with V3's existing residual-volatility eligibility and sizing mechanics.
Large/liquid and post-publication evidence is mixed to weak, with no decisive MAX-specific net-cost validation.
unblock_conditions: Verified effective-dated point-in-time common-stock taxonomy with fail-closed unknown types.
Synthetic proof of final-completed-calendar-month-close decision and first-next-tradable-open execution.
A new pre-outcome design review that reassesses literature and distinctness without inspecting candidate economics.
